_comment: Visual-baseline coverage manifest — the source of truth for which screens
are pixel-baselined, which are exempt (and why), and which are still owed a
baseline. Enforced by scripts/check-visual-coverage.mjs (CI job
`visual-coverage`).
Why this exists: a visual-regression suite that quietly skips screens gives
false confidence — a green run only means the screens someone remembered to
add are unchanged. This manifest forces every route under app/ to be
accounted for: a screen is either `baselined`, `exempt` with a documented
engineering reason, or `pending` with a tracking reference. A new screen
that is none of those fails the build, exactly like the README feature
matrix (scripts/check-feature-matrix.mjs) and the coverage floors.
Ratchet protocol: drive `pending` entries to `baselined` by adding the
`expectScreenToMatchBaseline(...)` call (see docs/visual-regression.md
'Adding a new screenshot') and committing the captured PNG. Never move a
screen to `exempt` just to make the count go up — exemptions are reviewed.
Once `pending` is empty, flip the job to --strict to lock 100% in.
Route keys are paths relative to app/ (matching the README matrix
shorthand). Names in `baselines`/`pendingBaselines` are the identifiers
passed to expectScreenToMatchBaseline() and the PNG file stem under
e2e/__baselines__/.

exemptCategories.redirect: Route renders only an expo-router <Redirect>; it has no visual surface of its own (its destinations are baselined separately).
exemptCategories.external-content: Route renders arbitrary remote content inside a WebView; there is no deterministic golden image to diff against.
exemptCategories.external-launcher: Route hands off to the OS browser or share sheet and renders no durable in-app surface of its own.
exemptCategories.dynamic-detail: Route is rendered entirely from a [param]; a meaningful pixel baseline needs a frozen data fixture and is tracked as a fixture-backed follow-up rather than a blank-state snapshot.

(auth)/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx.note: dashboard-with-pin-legal is asserted only in the PIN+legal feature-variant run; its PNG is captured by that variant and not yet committed.

index.tsx.reason: Entry route resolves auth state and returns only <Redirect> to welcome / verify / dashboard, all of which are baselined.

(auth)/webview.tsx.reason: Loads external URLs (KYC iframe, payment hand-off) inside a <WebView> behind the safe-url allow-list; remote content has no stable golden.

(auth)/legal/index.tsx.reason: Hands a list of legal-document URLs to the OS browser via Linking; the screen renders no durable in-app surface.

(auth)/portfolio/[symbol].tsx.reason: Asset-detail view rendered entirely from the :symbol param and live price data; a stable baseline needs a frozen pricing fixture (tracked).

(auth)/transaction-history/[id].tsx.reason: Transaction-detail view rendered entirely from the :id param; a stable baseline needs a frozen transaction fixture (tracked).

(auth)/linked-wallet/[address].tsx.reason: Linked-wallet detail rendered entirely from the :address param; a stable baseline needs a frozen wallet fixture (tracked).

(onboarding)/create-passkey.tsx.reason: Passkey-create onboarding screen; reachable without a backend — capture after the passkey-variant build is wired into the visual workflow.

(onboarding)/restore-passkey.tsx.reason: Passkey-restore onboarding screen; reachable without a backend — capture alongside create-passkey.

(onboarding)/verify-seed.tsx.reason: Seed-verification onboarding step; needs the generated-mnemonic state from create-wallet carried into the visual flow.

(auth)/(tabs)/settings.tsx.reason: Settings tab; reachable from the onboarded dashboard — capture once a settings-tab testID anchor is added.

(auth)/wallets/index.tsx.reason: Wallets list; reachable from the onboarded dashboard — capture with the deterministic single-wallet seed.

(auth)/portfolio/index.tsx.reason: Portfolio overview; needs onboarded state plus a frozen balance fixture for a stable baseline.

(auth)/portfolio/manage.tsx.reason: Asset-management screen; needs onboarded state plus the asset-list fixture.

(auth)/buy/index.tsx.reason: DFX buy flow; needs onboarded state and a mocked DFX backend response before a deterministic baseline.

(auth)/sell/index.tsx.reason: DFX sell flow; needs onboarded state and a mocked DFX backend response before a deterministic baseline.

(auth)/kyc/index.tsx.reason: KYC entry; needs onboarded state and a mocked DFX KYC-status response before a deterministic baseline.

(auth)/pay/index.tsx.reason: Pay landing; needs onboarded state — capture once a pay-screen testID anchor is added.

(auth)/multi-sig/index.tsx.reason: Multi-sig overview; needs onboarded state — capture with the deterministic single-wallet seed.

(auth)/multi-sig/setup.tsx.reason: Multi-sig setup; needs onboarded state — capture alongside the multi-sig overview.

(auth)/contact/index.tsx.reason: DFX contact screen; needs onboarded state with the DFX backend feature on.

(auth)/support/index.tsx.reason: DFX support screen; needs onboarded state with the DFX backend feature on.

(auth)/email/index.tsx.reason: DFX email screen; needs onboarded state with the DFX backend feature on.

(auth)/dfx-login/index.tsx.reason: DFX e-mail login; needs onboarded state with the DFX backend feature on.

(auth)/tax-report/index.tsx.reason: Tax-report screen; needs onboarded state and a mocked DFX transaction list before a deterministic baseline.

(auth)/hardware-connect/index.tsx.reason: Hardware-wallet connect; needs onboarded state — capture with the simulated BitBox platform's empty-scan state.

(auth)/seed-export.tsx.reason: Seed-export screen; needs onboarded state with the deterministic single-wallet seed.

(auth)/transaction-history/index.tsx.reason: Transaction-history list; needs onboarded state and a frozen transaction fixture for a stable baseline.
